title: Medicare Program; Medicare Appeals; Adjustment to the Amount in Controversy Threshold Amounts for Calendar Year 2027
abstract: This notice announces the annual adjustment in the amount in controversy (AIC) threshold amounts for Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) hearings and judicial review under the Medicare appeals process. The adjustment to the AIC threshold amounts will be effective for requests for ALJ hearings and judicial review filed on or after January 1, 2027. title: Announcement of Requirements and Registration for “EHIgnite Challenge”
abstract: The EHIgnite Challenge addresses data usability challenges in single patient electronic health information (EHI) exports.
